name: posture_any_config_violation_disables_capture
reason: an invalid configuration key was clamped and reported — `config print` reports the default and state/config-violations.json names the key — and an ordinary capture under the same configuration was still retained.
detail: config print reports runtime.telemetry.enabled=false and the §11.3 list names it afterwards=true; violations recorded by the hook path alone=1; ordinary capture retained=true; daemon reachable within 10s=true
